The '''234X augmented spin barrel''', also known as the '''"Penetrator" augmented spin barrel''' was a model of [[Augmented spin barrel/Legends|augmented spin barrel]] produced by the company [[Dolmax/Legends|Dolmax]] and sold for 1750 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The barrel increased damage output and [[Armor/Legends|armor]] penetration of any weapon it was attached to but also increased maintenance requirements and downtime due to increased wear and tear on the barrel and frame. Only compatible with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and [[Heavy blaster rifle/Legends|heavy blaster rifles]], the attachment was available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 234X was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]].
